description:
About the Position

This FNS doctorate investigates how AI processing can be distributed across embedded devices, edge infrastructure and the cloud while meeting communication and computing constraints.

Research Position Overview

Study split inference, adaptive model partitioning and computation offloading. Evaluate adaptation to changes in network capacity, sensing, energy and available computing resources.

Research Areas

  • Physical AI
  • Distributed and edge intelligence
  • 6G resource orchestration

Funding and Duration

Employment and financial support
ComponentDetails
PositionPaid doctoral employee
Salary€3,204–€4,051 gross/month; first-to-fourth-year progression
Additional pay8% holiday allowance; 8.3% year-end bonus
DurationFour years in principle: 18 months initially, then 30 months after satisfactory assessment
Programme / supportFuture Network Services (FNS).

Eligibility and Requirements

Academic and research preparation
CriterionRequirement
Academic preparationCompleted or nearly completed MSc in a relevant computer-science discipline.
Relevant skillsRelevant technical preparation, practical research interest and English proficiency.
EnglishRequired; see TU Delft’s admission policy for accepted evidence and exemptions.
Specific conditionsApplications are reviewed as received; selection may include assignments.

Application dates

Recruitment information
ComponentDetails
StatusOpen when verified against the official source
Deadline1 November 2026
Start dateNot specified
LocationDelft, Netherlands

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

  • CV, motivation letter, BSc/MSc degree copies and transcripts.

Use the application button on the official advert; email enquiries do not replace an online application.

About TU Delft and the Host Faculty

TU Delft is a technical university in Delft, Netherlands. This position is hosted by the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Mathematics and Computer Science. Doctoral employment includes Graduate School training and supervision.

Official Link

Application guides

English language requirements

No IELTS or TOEFL certificate is requested for this employed Dutch position; English is assessed through the application documents and an interview in English.
